label: lpm-descriptive-decline-codes
content:
# Changes the set of decline codes used for Alma, Amazon Pay, Billie, Satispay, and South Korean payment methods

## What’s new

Adds more granular decline codes to inform you of why a payment method was declined.

## Impact

The updated [decline codes](https://docs.stripe.com/declines/codes.md) for [PaymentIntents](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents.md?api-version=2025-09-30.preview)are noted in the [last_payment_error.decline_code](https://docs.stripe.com/api/payment_intents/object.md?api-version=2025-09-30.preview#payment_intent_object-last_payment_error-decline_code) field. You can also see the decline reason on the [Transactions](https://dashboard.stripe.com/test/payments) page in the Dashboard. You should update your integration accordingly if your integration relies on this field.

## Upgrade

#### REST API

1. [View your current API version](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2025-09-30.clover`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about [Stripe API upgrades](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
